_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in YOUR OWN ids. Never commit real API keys — those live in your shell env or the connector, never in this file.

avatar._note: Generate ONE continuous master per reel. If your provider's vertical auto-crop misframes the face, generate 16:9 and crop with a measured face-x instead.

faceFraming._note: Horizontal face-centre as a fraction of frame width. Measure it once per avatar on a mid frame (overlay a grid), save per reel to public/assets/<slug>/face-x.txt.

voiceClone._note: Optional. A clean ~18s sample of your own voice. Free community GPU space with a daily quota.
